references.view: Preview: anchor, cap, belly emblem and clothing; tips and boots partially cropped
Gameplay: side shape and tail; combat effects obscure some parts

model_lookup: Exact English-name model search did not yield a usable model. Rear and complete tail geometry unverified.
anchor_method: midpoint of opaque pixels in bottom 2 percent band
visual_review: At 100px the cyan belly mark and large anchor remain recognizable. Chain openings, tiny hat decoration and tail tips become coarse.
provisional_details: Full anchor and tail tips and the chain loop are interpreted from the cropped and partly occluded references.
measurement_scope: Local rectangle counts at fixed display size. Native frame time remains unmeasured.
